1.web: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?
1.asv: I will lift up mine eyes unto the mountains: From whence shall my help come?

2.web: My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
2.asv: My helpcomethfrom Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.

3.web: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.
3.asv: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: He that keepeth thee will not slumber.

4.web: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
4.asv: Behold, he that keepeth Israel Will neither slumber nor sleep.

5.web: Yahweh is your keeper. Yahweh is your shade on your right hand.
5.asv: Jehovah is thy keeper: Jehovah is thy shade upon thy right hand.

6.web: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
6.asv: The sun shall not smite thee by day, Nor the moon by night.

7.web: Yahweh will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.
7.asv: Jehovah will keep thee from all evil; He will keep thy soul.

8.web: Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
8.asv: Jehovah will keep thy going out and thy coming in From this time forth and for evermore.
